title: game/actions.json
description: The actions (W05, design 10.7): for each pair of a held item (use) and a station fixture (on), the verbs a step may use with them. A pair lists two verbs only when they are different acts with different results (sacar, abrir); synonyms are one act with one verb. Every verb is a lexicon lemma with a tu imperative. Loaded by ActionTable (Vocaterra.Game.Core).

use.description: The noun the learner uses: the id of a catalogue noun: an item held (flour), a hand (hand) or a tool (spoon).

on.description: The station fixture the act is done on (bowl, oven): the id of a catalogue noun.
